title: tdh.math.timeConversions
description: `tdh.math.timeConversions` converts pulse timing among milliseconds, beats per second (BPS), and beats per minute (BPM), making it useful for translating between duration or delay values and musical tempo specifications. Supply a value in any of these forms at the corresponding inlet; the outlets report the equivalent values in milliseconds, BPS, and BPM for uses such as setting `metro` timing.
